title: fix(lint): state-machine-no-initial-states judges only insert-running machines, and field-group-shadowed judges the six highlights the record page draws

Fixes #35251
Part of #35252 — folded into this PR whole; the chain head #35251 carries the fold's record, so #35252 is shut by hand with a Delivered note after merge.
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #35245 — an update-only state machine needs no `initialStates` (skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md; scope note 7018552906); the six-highlight strip is taught nowhere in `skills/**`

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用作者发布时,只在更新时运行的状态机不再被要求填写"初始状态";详情页顶部要点条遮住整组字段时,检查按页面实际显示的六项来判断,不再只看前四项。
- 为什么做:两条发布检查与运行时的真实行为对不上——前者逼作者写运行时根本不读的配置,后者漏报详情页上整组字段消失的情况。
- 出错会怎样:第一条只会少拒绝;第二条可能让少数应用多出一条警告(只在严格模式下导致校验失败),本仓全部示例与平台对象实测零新增;可直接回滚。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Two cards, one mechanism: a `packages/lint` rule judged a scope the runtime does not. One commit per card, #35251 first.

### #35251 — `state-machine-no-initial-states` judges only machines that run on insert

- The rule (`packages/lint/src/validate-inert-object-declarations.ts`) now skips a `state_machine` whose `events` leave out `insert`. Predicate `runsOnInsert(events)`: absent (or null) takes the schema default, an explicit list must contain `insert`; so `['update']` and `[]` are not judged. The hint is unchanged.
- Spec read before writing it: `packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts:149` declares `events: z.array(z.enum(['insert','update'])).default(['insert','update'])`, so an omitted `events` runs on insert.
- Engine read: `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:3938-3939` drops every rule whose `events ?? ['insert','update']` does not include the write mode, before `checkStateMachine` runs; its `initialStates` branch is `if (mode === 'insert')` at `:4209`. An update-only machine therefore never reads `initialStates`.
- Showcase: the three declaration-only lists are gone — `showcase_account` `account_lifecycle` `['prospect']`, `showcase_project` `project_health_progression` `['green']`, `showcase_task` `task_status_flow` `['backlog','todo']`. Each machine is now byte-identical to its form before #35244 (`git diff f4dbcc21^` on each of the three files: 0 changed lines). No showcase test or doc asserts them: `seed.test.ts` reads only machines that declare `initialStates`, and `new-project-wizard-initial-status.test.ts` and `seed/index.ts` read `project_status_flow`, which runs on insert and keeps `['planned']`.
- Prose that the narrowing made false, corrected in the same commit (restating the card's scope line "The rule judges only machines that run on insert"): the `initialStates` `.describe()` in `validation.zod.ts` (+ regenerated `content/docs/references/data/validation.mdx`), the `os explain` paragraph in `rule-explanations.ts`, and the unreleased upgrade-guide entry `18.publish-refuses-metadata-the-runtime-ignores.ts`.

### #35252 — `field-group-shadowed` judges the six highlights the record page hoists

- New `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX = 6` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`), the one source. `@objectstack/lint` depends on `@objectstack/spec` and on nothing under `ui/**`, so the constant lives there and the UI imports it.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` re-exports it as its own `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` (module export only; the package entry never exported it) — same value, the page is unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-semantic-roles.ts` rule (d) cuts at `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` instead of `slice(0, 4)`, and its hint reads "first 6 highlightFields".
- The lint mirrors the renderer on the points that decide the strip: non-string entries dropped, the title field filtered out BEFORE the cut (`deriveHighlightFields`), `hidden: true` members not counted.
- Upgrade-guide entry `18.field-group-shadowed-six-highlights.ts`, ADR-0087 disposition `registered field-group-shadowed-six-highlights`.

**Which stacks the rule now refuses that it passed:** an object with a field group whose every visible member is the title or a highlight in position 5 or 6 (after the title leaves the list) gets a `field-group-shadowed` warning; `os lint --strict` / `os validate --strict` exits 1 on it. Measured on this tree: every `*.object.ts` under `packages/**` and `examples/**` (135 objects from 132 files, old 4-cut vs new 6-cut side by side) — 0 new findings, 0 removed; the 2 files that would not load in the scratch harness (`plugin-audit` `sys-activity` with 4 highlights, `sys-audit-log` with none) cannot change verdict.

**The card's "a valid list is refused" half does not hold.** The strip hides the first N, so the fields the first 4 hide are a subset of the fields the first 6 hide: every list the 4-cut warned, the 6-cut warns too. The hotcrm example confirms it: `owner_id` sixth also empties the `assignment` group on the 18.6.0 page, so dropping it was the right fix, and the 4-cut passing the sixth position was the defect. No carve-out was added.

## Tests

- `validate-inert-object-declarations.test.ts`: new negative pins (update-only machine and `events: []` with no `initialStates` are silent; an `object` write whose only machine is update-only passes the runtime publish gate) and a control (explicit `['insert']`, `['update','insert']` and the default are still refused, `rule` code and `path` asserted).
- `validate-semantic-roles.test.ts`: new pin — a group whose only member sits 5th or 6th is warned (`rule`, `severity`, `path`, the group, and the hint's "first 6"), with a 4-of-6 control that stays clean. Fixture triage: two fixtures pinned the 4-cut itself — the strip-cap case (now 8 entries, the 7th past the cap) and the #6326 `primaryField` pair (now 7 entries) — both replaced so each still discriminates under 6.
- Ablations (each restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, printed by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`):
  - deleting `if (!runsOnInsert(rule.events)) continue;` → 2 failed / 7 passed (the two update-only pins);
  - `slice(0, RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX)` → `slice(0, 4)` → 2 failed / 29 passed (the six-highlight pin and the #6326 pair).

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, as the claim states: the every-option `initialStates` residual (comment 6992730706, `crm_opportunity` in app-crm). Not touched; the rule still passes an every-option list.
- The renderer hides one more field the lint does not model: `headerDrawnFields` also drops the stage field from the body when the page draws `record:path` (`detectStatusField` + options). A group whose only member is that field is empty on the page and not warned. Read only, not reproduced on a running page; filed as #35630 (read only, not reproduced).
- Two more literal sixes stay outside this diff's surface: `HIGHLIGHT_FIELDS_MAX` (Studio's highlight editor) and `HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` in `ui/packages/fields/src/RecordHoverCard.tsx`. Both agree today; they could read the spec constant too.
- The rule's own `.changeset/34776-publish-checks-build-probes.md` sentence ("an active `state_machine` validation without `initialStates` … lets a record be created already in any state") is unreleased and now broader than the rule; this PR's changeset states the narrowing in the same release rather than editing that note.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-inert-object-declarations.test.ts src/validate-semantic-roles.test.ts` — expect 2 files, 40 tests, all green.

Read first:
1. `packages/lint/src/validate-inert-object-declarations.ts` — `runsOnInsert`, the predicate (a wrong default here re-opens or hides the whole rule).
2. `packages/lint/src/validate-semantic-roles.ts` rule (d) — the cut moves from 4 to the spec constant.
3. `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` — the new `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` export (a public spec surface).

Local readings for head 1c2b8040 (the final head: a clean merge of origin/main 5c5b54d3 onto 18224af0; the PR's own diff vs main is unchanged, same `git patch-id --stable` 43a14c36). The package and gate readings below were taken at f76bbfba; 18224af0 changes only the Clause-② line of the #35252 changeset. On the merge head the spec build + `check:generated` (14 of 14 up to date), the two lint test files (40 tests), the spec migration tests (198 tests), the ADR-0087 registration, no-major, NUL-byte and overlap checks were rerun, all exit 0.
